purpose: do the siphonophore Mycoplasmatales, or close relatives, occur in Cassiopea tissue, and are they host-specific relative to water, sediment and swab controls
source: Florida Keys Cassiopea microbiome (BioProjects PRJNA1020388, Illumina V3-V4; PRJNA1020446, PacBio HiFi full-length 16S); ENA run manifest with MD5s frozen 2026-10-03

primers.note: 341F/805R; checked on SRR26155636, where reads start with the primer at position 1

match.note: matches are reported from 90% to show related lineages; full-length PacBio identity >= 98.7% is the species-level 16S threshold (Yarza et al. 2014)
